questions.q: What could you hear from the ground in the silence between burns?
options: A dog barking, a gate clanging, a rooster crowing

questions.q: How did the distant balloon greet you?
options: Two burner flashes, answered with two of your own
Its pilot waved a red flag

questions.q: What tradition did the pilot reveal after landing?
options: You always land with a picnic
You always name the wind that carried you
You bury a coin where you land
